title: Electrodeposition of Cu nanoparticles on TiO2 nanotubes for enhanced bactericidal effect against Escherichia coli
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44314-44327
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07012K, Paper

Naser Edraki, Elnaz Moslehifard, AmirAli Farmani, Ali Baradar Khoshfetrat, Farzad Nasirpouri
Effective and environmentally friendly disinfection methods are crucial for preventing infections and deaths. In this work, we produced anodic TiO2 nanotubes (TNTs) composited with copper nanoparticles via electrodeposition.
